result:
The full suite passes. Click confirmed all 4 shards (`test_alpha`, `test_beta`, `test_gamma`, `test_delta`) are valid against the current tree — the final run reused the passing receipts since nothing changed after the last green run.

Bugs fixed, one module at a time:

- **`ledger/alpha.py`** — `paginate` treated the 1-based `page` as 0-based (`start = page * size`), so page 1 skipped the first `size` items and the last page came back empty. Changed to `(page - 1) * size`.
- **`ledger/beta.py`** — `allocate` computed `leftover` but never distributed it, so shares summed to less than the total. Implemented the largest-remainder hand-out using integer `//` and `%` (no float rounding), with ties broken by position so `[1,1,1]` → `[34, 33, 33]`.
- **`ledger/gamma.py`** — `slugify`'s regex `[^a-z0-9]` replaced each separator character individually, so `",  "` became `"---"`. Added `+` so runs of separators collapse to a single dash.

Files changed:
- `ledger/alpha.py`
- `ledger/beta.py`
- `ledger/gamma.py`

Nothing under `tests/` was touched; `ledger/delta.py` was already passing and was left alone.
